against each other. If they are identical, that is a useful fact in itself --
it says the absorbed bake changes did not move census-visible values, which is
worth one line in your ledger. If they differ, you will want to know by how
much before your merge, because your sentinel red (breached-delving-count 11 vs
committed 1) is measured against whichever set you land.

MY EARLIER "0 BEHIND" ERROR IS STILL THE ONE TO WATCH FOR HERE. I asserted a
number without checking it, and the correction is what led you to absorb. That
was the right move regardless -- census after the last absorb is the standing
